pairs: Post hæc autem verba in regno Artaxerxis regis Persarum,
Now after these things, during the reign of Artaxerxes, the king of the Persians,
the son of Aaron, priest from the beginning,
this same Ezra, ascended from Babylon;
et ipse scriba velox in lege Moysi,
and he was a proficient scribe in the law of Moses,
which the Lord God gave to Israel.
et dedit ei rex secundum manum Domini Dei ejus super eum,
And the king granted to him his every petition. For the hand of the Lord,
And some from the sons of Israel,
and from the sons of the priests,
and from the sons of the Levites,
and from the temple servants ascended to Jerusalem,
in the seventh year of king Artaxerxes.
Et venerunt in Jerusalem mense quinto,
And they arrived at Jerusalem in the fifth month,
in the same seventh year of the king.
Quia in primo die mensis primi cœpit ascendere de Babylone,
For on the first day of the first month, he began to ascend from Babylon,
et in primo die mensis quinti venit in Jerusalem,
and on the first day of the fifth month, he arrived at Jerusalem.
juxta manum Dei sui bonam super se.
For the good hand of his God was over him.
so that he might search the law of the Lord,
et faceret et doceret in Israël præceptum et judicium.
and so that he might keep and teach precept and judgment in Israel.
Hoc est autem exemplar epistolæ edicti,
Now this is a copy of the letter of the edict,
quod dedit rex Artaxerxes Esdræ sacerdoti,
which king Artaxerxes gave to Ezra,
scribæ erudito in sermonibus et præceptis Domini,
a scribe well-taught in the words and precepts of the Lord and in his ceremonies in Israel:
Artaxerxes rex regum Esdræ sacerdoti scribæ legis Dei cæli doctissimo, salutem.
“Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra, the priest, a very learned scribe of the law of the God of heaven: a greeting.
It has been decreed by me,
ut cuicumque placuerit in regno meo de populo Israël, et de sacerdotibus ejus,
that whosoever wishes, among the people of Israel and their priests and Levites within my kingdom,
et de Levitis, ire in Jerusalem,
For you have been sent from the face of the king
so that you may visit Judea
ut visites Judæam et Jerusalem in lege Dei tui,
and Jerusalem by the law of your God,
et ut feras argentum et aurum quod rex,
and so that you may carry the silver and gold,
et consiliatores ejus, sponte obtulerunt Deo Israël,
which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel,
And all the silver and gold,
et aurum quodcumque inveneris in universa provincia Babylonis,
as much as you will find in the entire province of Babylon,
and which the people will wish to offer,
et de sacerdotibus quæ sponte obtulerint domui Dei sui,
and which some of the priests will offer freely to the house of their God,
et studiose eme de hac pecunia vitulos,
et offer ea super altare templi Dei vestri,
and offer these upon the altar of the temple of your God,
Sed et si quid tibi et fratribus tuis placuerit de reliquo argento et auro ut faciatis,
But also, whatever it will please you and your brothers to do with the remainder of the silver and gold,
do so in accord with the will of your God.
quæ dantur tibi in ministerium domus Dei tui,
the vessels that have been given to you for the ministry of the house of your God,
trade in conspectu Dei in Jerusalem.
deliver these to the sight of God in Jerusalem.
quibus opus fuerit in domum Dei tui,
whatever more will be needed for the house of your God,
as much as is necessary for you to spend,
it shall be given from the treasury,
statui atque decrevi omnibus custodibus arcæ publicæ,
have appointed and decreed to all the keepers of the public treasury,
those who are beyond the river,
ut quodcumque petierit a vobis Esdras sacerdos,
that whatever Ezra, the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven,
scriba legis Dei cæli, absque mora detis,
shall ask of you, you shall provide it without delay,
even up to one hundred talents of silver,
et usque ad frumenti coros centum,
and up to one hundred cors of wheat,
et usque ad vini batos centum,
and up to one hundred baths of wine,
et usque ad batos olei centum,
and up to one hundred baths of oil,
Omne quod ad ritum Dei cæli pertinet,
All that pertains to the rite of the God of heaven,
tribuatur diligenter in domo Dei cæli:
let it be distributed scrupulously to the house of the God of heaven,
ne forte irascatur contra regnum regis,
lest perhaps he may become angry against the kingdom of the king
Vobis quoque notum facimus de universis sacerdotibus,
Likewise, we would make known to you, about all the priests,
and the ministers of the house of this God,
et annonas non habeatis potestatem imponendi super eos.
that you have no authority to impose tax, or tribute, or duty upon them.
in accord with the wisdom of your God,
ut judicent omni populo qui est trans flumen,
so that they may judge the entire people,
his videlicet qui noverunt legem Dei tui:
especially so that they may know the law of your God,
but also so as to teach the ignorant freely.
Et omnis qui non fecerit legem Dei tui,
And anyone who will not diligently keep the law of your God,
and the law of the king,
judicium erit de eo sive in mortem,
or to the confiscation of his goods,
Blessed be the Lord, the God of our fathers,
qui dedit hoc in corde regis ut glorificaret domum Domini quæ est in Jerusalem,
who has put this into the heart of the king, so that he may glorify the house of the Lord, which is in Jerusalem.
et in me inclinavit misericordiam suam coram rege et consiliatoribus ejus,
For he has turned his mercy toward me in the sight of the king, and his counselors,
and all the powerful leaders of the king. And so,
et ego confortatus manu Domini Dei mei,
having been strengthened by the hand of the Lord, my God,
congregavi de Israël principes qui ascenderent mecum.
I gathered together some of the leaders of Israel, those who were to go up with me.
